title: Homology transport for the previous quotient chart model
statement: With the data of lem-weil-pbc-finite-quotient-previous-local-complexes-chart and a supplied chart comparison e, let Q be the complex obtained from P by restriction of scalars along A/I^(n+2) → A/I^(n+1). Then, in every integer degree q, the slice homology of finiteQuotientPreviousObject is isomorphic to the slice realization over φ_(n+1) of the homology of Q.

source.place: Tags 0942, 094H and 094I, exact realization on the previous-model cover

proof.text: Restriction of module sheaves along a ring-sheaf isomorphism is an equivalence: compose restrictions using the sectionwise identity linear equivalences, and use the inverse ring map. Apply the ordinary scalar-extension/restriction adjunction to conclude that completedAdicChange along each phi_n is an equivalence, hence exact. The universal left-derived property identifies completedAdicDerivedChange with the termwise exact-functor localization, on every complex, without a K-flat or boundedness assumption.

Use exact slice restriction and the Mathlib localization homology factorization to identify homology of ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses K with slice restriction of H^q(K). Exact constant realization, the universe-lift functor, and scalar extension along phi_n identify homology of the realized algebraic complex P with finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor applied to H^q(P). Apply slice homology to the supplied isomorphism e and compose these comparisons.

Construct the constant-restriction comparison on module sheafifications. On each object use the unit of sheafification of the constant D-module; naturality of ring sheafification makes this map linear over the constant B-ring after a homomorphism B to D. Its underlying abelian-presheaf map is the usual locally bijective sheafification unit, so its induced sheaf map is an isomorphism. Restrict the desired coefficient comparison along phi_(n+1). The compatibility square in FinitePerfectModelsCompatible and composition of restrictions identify it with this constant-restriction comparison and the invertible units of the two scalar-extension adjunctions. Full faithfulness of restriction along phi_(n+1) lifts the isomorphism back.

Compute homology of finiteQuotientPreviousObject by exact restriction of its specified canonical representative. Restrict the slice homology isomorphism from e along the quotient map on the slice; scalar restriction and slice restriction commute on the nose. Compose with the coefficient comparison. Finally use exactness of algebraic restriction of scalars to replace restricted H^q(P) by H^q(Q), giving precisely the claimed successor-coefficient slice isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0942, 094H and 094I; the exact previous-quotient realization step, implemented by K2 using module sheafification, the ordinary coefficient adjunction, and Mathlib exact-functor localization and homology comparisons.

theorem finiteQuotient_previous_local_complexes_chart_homology
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n))
    (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (V : X.Etale) (W Z : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V) (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) ℤ)
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d n).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d n)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ n)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X _ P))))) :
    let qring : A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1) →+* A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1)
    let Q := ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars qring).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    ∀ q : ℤ, Nonempty
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            (finiteQuotientPreviousObject X d M n)) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
          ((finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X
            (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)) (φ (n + 1))).obj (Q.homology q)))
